data.name: Everilda
data.gender_notes: Everilda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Strong as an Ever, Hidden as an Ilda
data.long_meaning: The name Everilda is derived from the Latin words 'Ever' meaning 'ever' and 'Ilda' meaning 'hidden'. It was popular during the Middle Ages and is a testament to the strength and hidden qualities of a woman. In Christian tradition, it is believed that the name Everilda embodies the faith and resilience of the saints, who remained steadfast in their beliefs despite facing adversity.
